title: evaluate_single_write_decision
description: Test POST /evaluate endpoint with a valid proposal, mandate, usage array, and now timestamp to verify it returns a 200 response with a decision of allow, hold, or deny and the correct reasons array.

title: evaluate_single_write_blocked_label_or_revoked_mandate
description: Test POST /evaluate endpoint with a proposal targeting a blocked label or revoked mandate to verify it returns a 200 response with a deny decision and appropriate reason codes such as BLOCKED_LABEL or MANDATE_REVOKED.

title: evaluate_single_write_invalid_request_body
description: Test POST /evaluate endpoint with invalid JSON body or missing proposal field to verify it returns a 400 response with an error message indicating validation failure.

title: evaluate_plan_bulk_simulation_success
description: Test POST /evaluate-plan endpoint with an ordered array of valid proposals and optional usage to verify it returns a 200 response with per-item results and summary counts reflecting correct allow, hold, and deny decisions.

title: evaluate_plan_exceed_limits_mid_sequence
description: Test POST /evaluate-plan endpoint with multiple proposals that exceed burst or hourly limits partway through the sequence to verify it returns a 200 response where later items are denied and earlier eligible items are allowed or held, ensuring refused items do not consume budget.

title: evaluate_plan_invalid_proposals_type
description: Test POST /evaluate-plan endpoint with proposals set to a non-array value to verify it returns a 400 response with an error message indicating invalid input.

title: mandate_default_retrieval
description: Test GET /mandate/default endpoint to verify it returns a 200 response with the default mandate including default projects, blocked labels, limits, hold rules, status, and expiry for pre-filling the admin configuration screen.

title: mandate_sanitize_valid_input
description: Test POST /mandate/sanitize endpoint with valid admin input and an optional previous mandate to verify it returns a 200 response with a normalized mandate and incremented version suitable for saving.

title: mandate_sanitize_invalid_input
description: Test POST /mandate/sanitize endpoint with invalid expiresAt value or perHour limit greater than perDay to verify it returns a 400 response with an error message and rejects the form submission, keeping the previous mandate unchanged.

title: health_check_liveness
description: Test GET /health endpoint to verify it returns a 200 response with { ok: true } indicating the local policy harness is running and ready for policy requests.

title: ledger_csv_export_format
description: POST /ledger/csv with three entries given out of time order (one allow with no reasons, one deny with reasons BLOCKED_LABEL and RUN_LIMIT, one hold approved by a person). Verify status 200, content-type text/csv, the exact header row decided_at,decision_id,source,actor,issue,action,change,verdict,rules,outcome,approved_by,approved_at,mandate_version,error, CRLF line endings, rows sorted oldest first by `at`, and the deny row's rules cell equal to 'BLOCKED_LABEL RUN_LIMIT'.

title: ledger_csv_export_escaping_and_formula_safety
description: POST /ledger/csv with entries whose `change` contains a comma, double quotes and a newline, and whose `change` or `error` starts with =, +, - or @. Verify RFC 4180 quoting (wrapped in double quotes, inner quotes doubled) and that every formula-like cell is prefixed with a single quote. Also verify POST /ledger/csv with entries that is not an array returns 400 with an error, and an empty array returns only the header row.
